title: adminutilities
body:
AdminUtilities - Essential Server Administration Plugin
A comprehensive Minecraft plugin designed specifically for server administrators (OP players) providing essential utility commands to enhance server management and gameplay experience.

✨ Features
🫥 Complete Invisibility (/inv)
Toggle complete invisibility mode for players
Unlike vanilla invisibility, this hides all equipment and items
Perfect for invisible moderation and oversight
✈️ Enhanced Flight Mode (/fly)
Toggle flight mode with smart fall damage protection
Automatically prevents fall damage when disabling flight
Seamless flying experience for administrators
❤️ Health Management
Instant Full Heal (/hpmax) - Restore health and hunger to maximum
Custom Max Health (/maxhp <value>) - Set custom maximum health values
Essential for testing and player assistance
🛡️ God Mode (/godmode)
Toggle invincibility mode
Maintains damage sounds and knockback for realistic feel
Perfect for building and exploration without interruption
🎩 Hat System (/hat)
Equip any item as a hat
Automatically swaps current helmet with held item
Great for cosmetic purposes and role-playing
✨ Particle Trails (/trails <type> [frequency])
Create stunning particle effects while moving
Supports multiple particle types: FLAME, HEART, NOTE, CLOUD, CRIT, VILLAGER_HAPPY, END_ROD, PORTAL
Customizable frequency settings
Use /trails off to disable
📢 Enhanced Broadcasting (/broadcast <message>)
Send eye-catching messages to all players
Perfect for server announcements and notifications
📦 Quick Ender Chest Access (/enderchest or /ec)
Access ender chest inventory from anywhere
No need to find or place ender chests
🔧 Advanced Repair System (/repair)
Instantly repair held items or all items
Supports both single item and full inventory repair
Essential for maintaining equipment
⚡ Enchantment Effects (/enchanteffect)
Apply visual enchantment effects to items
Enhance item appearance for special occasions
🛠️ Technical Details
Compatibility: Spigot/Paper 1.19.2+
Java Version: Java 8+
Permissions: All commands default to OP-only with granular permission nodes
Data Persistence: Player states automatically saved and restored
Performance: Lightweight with minimal server impact
📋 Command Reference
Command	Description	Permission
/inv	Toggle complete invisibility	adminutils.inv
/fly	Toggle flight mode	adminutils.fly
/hpmax	Restore full health and hunger	adminutils.hpmax
/maxhp <value>	Set maximum health	adminutils.maxhp
/godmode	Toggle invincibility	adminutils.godmode
/hat	Equip held item as hat	adminutils.hat
/trails <type> [freq]	Particle trail effects	adminutils.trails
/broadcast <msg>	Server-wide announcements	adminutils.broadcast
/enderchest or /ec	Open ender chest	adminutils.enderchest
/repair [all]	Repair items	adminutils.repair
/enchanteffect	Apply enchant glow	adminutils.enchanteffect
🔐 Permissions
adminutils.* - Access to all commands (default: OP)
Individual permissions for each command available
Fine-grained control for delegation of specific abilities
🚀 Installation
Download the latest release from this page
Place the JAR file in your server's plugins folder
Restart your server or use /reload
Commands are immediately available to OP players
🎯 Perfect For
Server Administrators looking for essential management tools
Build Teams needing creative mode enhancements
Moderators requiring invisible oversight capabilities
Event Organizers wanting special effects and abilities
Testing Environments with custom health and invincibility needs
🔄 Data Persistence
All player states (invisibility, flight, god mode) are automatically saved and restored between sessions, ensuring consistent experience across server restarts.

Note: This is a server-side plugin that requires Spigot or Paper. All features work in both single-player and multiplayer environments.
